List<Object> displayRows(ScreenConfig cfg,
        {required bool showCassetteVariant}) => switch (cfg) {

// DISPLAY — per-screen knobs.
        _Group('DISPLAY'),
        if (kDebugMode || (!kIsWeb && Platform.isMacOS))
          _Toggle('void-settings-debug-layout', 'debug layout',
              settings.debugLayoutNotifier.value, settings.toggleDebugLayout),
        ...displayRows(cfg,
            showCassetteVariant: !(Platform.isLinux && cfg.type == ScreenType.cassette)),
